title: Build for the web from zero
summary: The Odin Project's Foundations course: set up your tools, learn Git, then HTML, CSS, Flexbox and JavaScript through real projects.

course.name: Foundations

freeEvidence.quote: The Odin Project provides a free open source coding curriculum that can be taken entirely online.
